1.source: Rewritten 2026-11-21 fresh from the public-domain King James Version (the earlier text followed modern Bibles in places), following the KJV's Greek text (Textus Receptus, checked against Moorman's 8,000 Differences), at a simple, Deaf-friendly reading level with hard KJV words explained in parentheses. V9 names Michael and the devil to keep them apart; v14-15 name Enoch and the Lord.

verses.text: Jude, the servant of Jesus Christ, and brother of James, to those who are sanctified (made holy) by God the Father, and preserved (kept) in Jesus Christ, and called:
Mercy to you, and peace, and love, be multiplied.

Beloved (dear friends), when I gave all diligence (worked hard) to write to you of the common salvation, I needed to write to you and exhort (encourage) you. You should earnestly contend (fight hard) for the faith which was once delivered (handed) to the saints (holy people).

For there are certain men crept in unawares (secretly), who were before of old ordained (marked out) to this condemnation (judgment). They are ungodly men, turning the grace of our God into lasciviousness (wild sinful living), and denying the only Lord God, and our Lord Jesus Christ.
So I will put you in remembrance, though you once knew this: the Lord, having saved the people out of the land of Egypt, afterward destroyed those who did not believe.
And the angels who did not keep their first estate (place), but left their own habitation (home), God has reserved (kept) in everlasting chains under darkness to the judgment of the great day.

Even as Sodom and Gomorrah, and the cities around them in the same way, gave themselves over to fornication (sexual sin), and went after strange flesh. They are set forth for an example, suffering the vengeance (punishment) of eternal fire.
In the same way also these filthy dreamers defile (make dirty) the flesh, despise (reject) dominion (authority), and speak evil of dignities (those in high places).

Yet Michael the archangel (chief angel), when he argued with the devil about the body of Moses, did not dare to bring a railing (insulting) accusation against the devil. But Michael said: The Lord rebuke (correct) you.
But these men speak evil of those things which they do not know. But what they know naturally, as brute (wild) beasts, in those things they corrupt (ruin) themselves.
Woe (great sorrow) to them. For they have gone in the way of Cain, and ran greedily after the error (wrong) of Balaam for reward, and perished in the gainsaying (arguing) of Core (Korah).

These are spots in your feasts of charity (love meals), when they feast with you, feeding themselves without fear. They are clouds without water, carried about by winds. They are trees whose fruit withers, without fruit, twice dead, plucked up by the roots.
They are raging waves of the sea, foaming out their own shame. They are wandering stars, for whom is reserved (kept) the blackness of darkness forever.
And Enoch also, the seventh from Adam, prophesied (spoke God's message) of these men, saying: Look, the Lord comes with ten thousands of His saints (holy ones),

To execute (carry out) judgment on all, and to convince (prove guilty) all who are ungodly among them of all their ungodly deeds which they have ungodly committed, and of all their hard speeches which ungodly sinners have spoken against the Lord.

These are murmurers (grumblers), complainers, walking after their own lusts (wrong desires). And their mouth speaks great swelling (proud) words, having men's persons in admiration (flattering people) to get advantage.
But, beloved (dear friends), remember the words which were spoken before by the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ.
They told you there should be mockers in the last time, who would walk after their own ungodly lusts (wrong desires).
These are those who separate themselves, sensual (of the body), not having the Spirit.
But you, beloved (dear friends), building up yourselves on your most holy faith, praying in the Holy Spirit,
Keep yourselves in the love of God, looking for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ to eternal life.
And of some have compassion, making a difference.
And others save with fear, pulling them out of the fire, hating even the garment spotted by the flesh.
Now to Him who is able to keep you from falling, and to present you faultless before the presence of His glory with exceeding (great) joy,
To the only wise God our Savior, be glory and majesty (greatness), dominion (rule) and power, both now and forever. Amen.
